records.rationale: A section preamble introducing the property list that follows; every obligation it points at is inventoried as its own clause and dispositioned there. A pointer sentence names no outcome, so it has nothing separately observable.

A scoping statement about the specification's own boundaries plus an expectation about user practice ('we do not expect users to store secrets inside devcontainer.json'). It places no requirement on an implementation, so no observation of deacon can satisfy or violate it.

A `should` about not forcing a rebuild when a secret's value changes. deacon reads `--secrets-file` afresh on every invocation and never bakes secret values into an image layer (they are injected into the process/exec environment), so no reachable state makes a value change require a rebuild; the property holds by construction of the ingress rather than as an outcome a channel discriminates.
